description: Desktop: SearchPick under a person's clicks, through gpui-agent's press (on Windows the real pointer path: agent.rs click -> synth::pointer -> input::pointer -> focus_pointer). New taxpayer form: five row presses after typing "makati" (the #425 Windows fault: 0/5 at c4262697), three chevron rounds, three presses away. Then the profile's RDO and ZIP: the same rounds and an error-line round (text that fits nothing, then Save below, on the first click). Desktop machines run it after smoke (scripts/e2e/machines/windows.ps1, macos.sh); by hand: `just e2e windows rdo-row-press` (or macos). Linux shows the narrow layout (known gap). Needs gpui-agent-cli 0.4.1 (paced typing): an older CLI cannot prove the #425 timing case, so the suite refuses to run there rather than fall back. See docs/proof/E2E.md.

known_gap.linux: the Linux window opens 420 px wide, under BREAK.phone (600), so the app shows the narrow layout and SearchPick is the phone sheet there (Pick.tsx SheetPick), not the desktop combobox this suite tests; the first step finds no <box>-search and changes nothing
